name: Gloucestershire Nature Recovery Fund
summary: Revenue funding from Gloucestershire's Local Nature Recovery Strategy team to help emerging nature recovery projects get going, such as project officer time, feasibility studies, engagement and specialist services. Projects must include on-the-ground nature recovery; capital costs are not funded.

eligibility.rule: Applies for a specific project, not a group's general activities
Project primarily supports or facilitates nature recovery and delivers a nature recovery activity
Gloucestershire project, or at least half in-county and with a demonstrable benefit for nature there
Single-site project has landowner support unless it is designed to engage landowners in nature recovery
The activity has no duplicate funding or subsidy
Applicant is financially viable, has clear controls and produces annual or management-approved accounts unless new
Organisation can receive at most one award per application window

applicant_types.quote: This could be: Community groups Parish councils Charitable organisations Landowners Farm clusters Businesses

geography.quote: The project is not within (or is largely outside of) Gloucestershire

access.quote: Please download and complete the below application form and send your completed form to lnrs@gloucestershire.gov.uk before the deadline to apply.

window.quote: There will be another application window around every six months for the next few years

amount.quote: Each project may apply for up to £15,000 per year.

effort.quote: Please download and complete the below application form and send your completed form to lnrs@gloucestershire.gov.uk before the deadline to apply.
The Panel that will agree scoring will consist of Key officers in GCC

eligibility.quote: the application must clearly be for a project, rather than for funding or supporting general activities of a group.

This fund and support offering must primarily be to support or facilitate nature recovery. Whilst we expect some projects to have “wider” benefits such as supporting nature connection or climate resilience, they must still deliver an element of nature recovery.
Some cross border projects may be supported where the benefit for nature within Gloucestershire is demonstrated and where at least half of the project/site is within Gloucestershire.

Single site projects dependant on getting wider support from stakeholders including the landowner will not be supported. The exception to this will be where part of the project design involves outreach to various stakeholders and landowners in order to facilitate and encourage nature recovery on their property/land.

projects may not apply for GCC nature recovery funding to fund an activity that is already subsidised or funded through other means (such as environmental land management schemes, or private finance).

All applicants must be financially viable; have clear financial controls and produce annual accounts (or management approved accounts); we may ask for these to be submitted on application. (In the case of applicants in their first year of activity where no accounts are available, you may still receive a grant, but we may contact you for further information).
a maximum of one application per organisation will be awarded per application window.

after_award.quote: By the end of the year the grantee shall submit to Gloucestershire County Council an evaluation form which will include the outcomes of the project to date and the benefits derived from the funds.
